It no longer needs to install fx inside the sandbox, run a sandbox bridge, or expose a sandbox port. Model credentials stay on the host rather than being forwarded into the sandbox. The rewrite also adds: Built-in tool filtering: choose which built-in tools the agent can use Mid-turn steering: send new instructions while a turn is running Structured output: generate responses that match a schema Image tool results: return images to the model through toModelOutput() Sessions can be saved and resumed in a new host process. items.summary: Vercel Sandbox now lets you send input to running commands through standard input (stdin). Use it to exchange messages with stdio MCP servers such as agent-browser , or send data to other command-line programs while they run. In the TypeScript SDK, set stdin: true and detached: true in runCommand() . Use writeStdin() to send input and closeStdin() when you’re done: You can also set stdin to a Node.js readable stream, such as process.stdin . The SDK forwards the stream’s data and closes the command’s standard input when the stream ends. In the Python SDK, set stdin=subprocess.PIPE and send input with server.stdin.send() . Call communicate() to close stdin, collect remaining output, and wait for the process to exit: For commands that receive all their input at once, you can pass input directly to Python’s run_process() . items.summaryJa: 動的UIやCSRを多用する商用Webでは、AIクローラーが本文を取得できないケースが多い。実データでは、英語圏の検証と国内3ノードの検証で、JavaScriptを実行しないインフラ要因により本文が欠落したり、ハルシネーションが発生するケースが確認された。特に、初期HTMLに本文が含まれない完全CSRサイトや、動的ボタンなど動的要素が後から挿入されるサイトでは、Geminiを除く独立系AIクローラーで本文取得の脱落・誤認識が生じることが示された。
